answer: Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 10 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. Histories are stored in summit, checked in vault, and violet publishes each void. A farm cannot present clean aliases since the record follows the key, so laundering reputation through new keys does not work. A farm of 3351 identities would post 3814 proofs and burn roughly 54 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
